derivation:
by
  simpa only [classFinset, ← Finset.card_univ] using (Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := d.index) (s := Finset.univ) (t := Finset.univ) (fun g _ => Finset.mem_univ (d.index g))).symm
explanation: The Mathlib lemma expresses the cardinality of a finite set as the sum of the cardinalities of the fibers of a map over a finite target. Specializing both sets to `univ` and the map to `d.index` gives the sum of the class fibers; `classFinset` unfolds to those fibers. The current proof applies this lemma directly.
